## Behavior key

- Easy pools are referenced directly by a Mission. Hard pools are gateway-referenced pools with serialized category Normal.
- Easy, Hard, and Elite encounters are selected only when their Stage tier matches a referencing Mission tier.
- Fixed opening encounters bypass pool selection. Referenced Boss pools are selected without a tier filter.
- Turn strategies are drawn randomly without replacement; after every strategy has been drawn, the strategy pool resets.
- A fuse-or-summon play fuses its first listed Soul with the first board Soul when possible, then summons remaining cards.
- Non-combat Event pools are omitted. Empty or unresolved values are shown explicitly.
